correctness.rationale: For every k,h>=1, the product Laplacian and Walsh basis reduce the Dirichlet problem to (L_h+2tI)a=0 off the origin; the resolvent ratio yields all Gram eigenvalues. The continuous-time hitting representation proves strict positive-weight monotonicity. The exact binomial sums reduce the global extremum to a rational sequence, with finite exact h<=7 verification and a rigorous 2^n>=n^3/2 inequality proving decrease for n>=8. The only extremizers are weight-one modes at h=4. Fourteen independently solved host Dirichlet examples matched to 4.26e-14; the infinite proof does not rely on finite tests.

value.rationale: Nested cubical faces are a canonical family of isometric graph-signal embeddings under dimension augmentation. Although energy-minimizing completion is standard, its host L2 distortion is not controlled by the Dirichlet variational principle. The theorem supplies all singular modes, sharp full-frame bounds, and a surprising dimension-independent mean-zero norm limit with a unique codimension-four worst case. This is a natural complete stability classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
